中午大家在食堂一起吃了午饭。还是二合面馒头、炖土豆、炒白菜、炖萝卜，今天没肉。王建新端着碗，三下五除二就吃完了，馒头掰开夹着菜，几口一个。

吃完饭，张团长把他叫到一边，说：“下午去政治处办理手续。之前的手续已经上报北京人民武装部和知青办，进行了外调政审。本来应该回北京配合体检，填写入伍登记表，但特事特办，直接在团党委填写资料。”

王建新点了点头。

下午，王建新来到政治处。政治处在办公楼的一层，几间办公室，门口挂着牌子。一个姓刘的干事接待了他，态度挺热情，一边填表一边跟他聊天。

“你的事迹我们都看了，了不起。”刘干事递给他一沓表格，“把这些填了。”

王建新坐在桌前，一笔一划地填写。入伍登记表、政审表、体检表——就是走个形式，填完表，刘干事核对了一遍，收起来。

王建新想起入团的事，他现在还在考察期，剩下的手续还没办完。他问刘干事：“刘干事，我入团的事，现在还在考察期，后面怎么办？”

刘干事说：“这个你放心。剩下的手续政治处会与团委联系，把组织关系转接过来。然后部队团组织会指派两名团员作为介绍人，继续完成后续的审批流程。”

他又补充道：“剩下的事情就是团党委将材料逐级上报至军政治部审核，由军区政治部下达批准命令，你的关系就正式转入部队了。提干程序也一并上报政治部。还有推荐上工农兵医学院，这些手续你只需要等待即可。”

王建新心里踏实了。政治处的手续办完，刘干事热情地带着他去后勤处。领了一套军装和挎包水壶绑腿。

“这是你的军装。提干手续还没下来，只能先穿士兵的。”

王建新双手接过军装，心里激动得很。他抱着军装回到宿舍，关上门，把军装抖开。一套崭新的六五式军装，草绿色的，领章是红色的，帽徽是红五角星。布料挺括，颜色鲜亮。

他脱了便服，一件一件地穿上。衬衣、外套、裤子、饭布武装带、帽子，解放鞋。穿好了，站到镜子前面——走廊尽头有一面穿衣镜，他走过去，站定了。

镜子里的自己，穿着崭新的军装，腰板挺直，帽子戴得端端正正。小伙子倍儿精神。王建新左看看右看看，满意得不行。他冲镜子里的自己笑了笑，转身回了宿舍。

下午，王建新想出去寄信。但他不知道该和谁请示，只能来到张团长办公室。

敲门，进去，立正敬礼。

张团长正在看文件，抬起头，看见穿着一身士兵军装的王建新，从上到下打量了一遍，满意地点了点头。

“有事？”

“首长，我想出去寄封信，给家里寄的。顺便可不可以去外边逛逛？”

张团长笑了，喊来勤务兵，让勤务兵带王建新去后勤处领一辆自行车，并为他开了出门许可证。一张小纸条，上面写着“王建新同志因公外出”，盖着团部的章。

王建新跟着勤务兵来到后勤办公室，领到了一辆自行车——不是新的，是旧的，但保养得好，骑着轻快。勤务兵又带他取上自行车，告知他回来后直接来这里还车即可。

王建新骑着自行车，到了团部门口，下车，出示许可证。哨兵看了看纸条，又看了看他，挥挥手让他过去了。

出了团部，王建新骑着自行车在旗里转悠。旗不大，就一条街上有一些国营商店。布店、五金店、国营饭店、供销社，一家挨着一家。街上人不多，偶尔有马车经过，马蹄踩在路上，哒哒哒地响。

他找到了邮局。邮局在一排平房中间，门口挂着绿色的招牌。王建新把自行车锁好，推门进去。邮局不大，一个柜台，一个窗口，卖邮票的老头戴着老花镜，坐在那里看报纸。

At noon, everyone had lunch together in the cafeteria.Still steamed buns with noodles, stewed potatoes, stir-fried cabbage, stewed radish, no meat today.Wang Jianxin held the bowl and finished eating in three swipes. He broke open the steamed buns and sandwiched the vegetables with each bite.

After dinner, Captain Zhang called him aside and said: "Go to the Political Department in the afternoon to complete the procedures. The previous procedures have been reported to the Beijing People's Armed Forces Department and the Educated Youth Office, and a political review for external transfer was carried out. I was supposed to return to Beijing to cooperate with the physical examination and fill in the registration form for the army, but for special matters, I filled in the information directly at the Youth League Party Committee."

Wang Jianxin nodded.

In the afternoon, Wang Jianxin came to the Political Department.The Political Department is on the first floor of the office building, with several offices and signs hanging on the doors.A clerk named Liu received him with a warm attitude and chatted with him while filling out the form.

"We've all seen your deeds. It's amazing." Officer Liu handed him a stack of forms and said, "Fill these in."

Wang Jianxin sat at the table and filled it out one stroke at a time.Enlistment form, political review form, physical examination form - just a formality. After filling out the form, Officer Liu checked it over and put it away.

Wang Jianxin thought about joining the league. He was still in the inspection period and the remaining procedures had not been completed.He asked Director Liu: "Director Liu, my joining the league is still in the inspection period. What should I do next?"

Officer Liu said: "Don't worry about this. For the rest of the procedures, the Political Office will contact the Youth League Committee and transfer the organizational relationship. Then the Army Corps Organization will appoint two league members as introducers to complete the subsequent approval process."

He added: "The only thing left is that the Youth League Party Committee will submit the materials to the Military Political Department for review. The Military Political Department will issue an approval order, and your relationship will be officially transferred to the army. The promotion process will also be reported to the Political Department. There will also be a recommendation to attend the Workers', Peasants' and Soldiers' Medical College. You just need to wait for these procedures."

Wang Jianxin felt at ease.After the formalities in the Political Department were completed, Officer Liu enthusiastically took him to the Logistics Department.I received a set of military uniforms and a satchel, water bottle, and leggings.

"This is your military uniform. I haven't finished the formalities yet, so I have to wear a soldier's uniform first."

Wang Jianxin took over the military uniform with both hands and was very excited.He carried the military uniform back to the dormitory, closed the door, and shook the military uniform away.A brand new 65-style military uniform, grass green, with a red collar badge and a red five-pointed star on the cap badge.The fabric is crisp and the colors are bright.

He took off his civilian clothes and put them on one by one.Shirt, jacket, trousers, rice cloth armed belt, hat, liberation shoes.After getting dressed, he stood in front of the mirror - there was a full-length mirror at the end of the corridor. He walked over and stood still.

The self in the mirror is wearing a brand new military uniform, with a straight back and a neatly worn hat.The young man is very energetic.Wang Jianxin looked left and right, extremely satisfied.He smiled at himself in the mirror and turned back to the dormitory.

In the afternoon, Wang Jianxin wanted to go out and send letters.But he didn't know who to ask for instructions, so he could only come to Captain Zhang's office.

Knock on the door, go in, stand at attention and salute.

Captain Zhang was reading documents. He raised his head and saw Wang Jianxin, who was wearing a soldier's uniform. He looked at it from top to bottom and nodded with satisfaction.

"Is something wrong?"

"Chief, I want to go out and send a letter to my family. Can I go for a walk by the way?"

Captain Zhang smiled, called the orderly, and asked the orderly to take Wang Jianxin to the logistics office to pick up a bicycle and issue a permit for him.A small piece of paper said "Comrade Wang Jianxin is out on official business" and was stamped with the regimental seal.

Wang Jianxin followed the orderly to the logistics office and received a bicycle - not a new one, but an old one, but well-maintained and riding briskly.The orderly took him to pick up his bicycle again and told him that he could return it directly here when he came back.

Wang Jianxin rode his bicycle to the entrance of the Youth League branch, got off the bicycle, and showed his permit.The sentry looked at the note, then at him, and waved him over.

After leaving the regiment headquarters, Wang Jianxin rode his bicycle around the flag.The flag is not big, there are only some state-owned shops on one street.Cloth stores, hardware stores, state-owned restaurants, and supply and marketing cooperatives are all located next to each other.There were not many people on the street. Occasionally, a carriage would pass by, and the horses' hooves would make a clicking sound on the road.

He found the post office.The post office is in the middle of a row of bungalows, with a green sign hanging at the door.Wang Jianxin locked the bicycle and pushed the door open.The post office is not big, with one counter and one window. The old man selling stamps is sitting there reading a newspaper wearing reading glasses.
